display_name: Phase1 independent clean IQ denoising prior
description: Train from scratch a clean-signal denoising prior using source IQ and frozen Tri-SIG-TIME features; no DURA architecture, weights or teacher.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU0, source-only training, CPU 2 threads, TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Clean source IQ plus synthetic Gaussian perturbation; network conditioned on noise level
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX source labels or U_s truth; only clean source IQ and frozen F soft outputs
data.validation_ref: RX4/6 source validation and RX8 source holdout excluded from training; later fixed restoration validation
data.leo_config_ref: Clean source L_s/U_s IQ, synthetic Gaussian noise levels .03/.08/.16/.32

permissions.query_use: L_s/U_s clean IQ and frozen F soft outputs only; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or test.
permissions.claim_scope: Prior training only, not a full restoration result or blind ground performance.

checkpoint.initialization: Fresh zero-residual denoiser; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; no DURA.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source L_s/U_s training physical IDs, fixed F, no DURA or other restoration checkpoint.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: 8192 randomly sampled source fit IDs disjoint from original prior IDs and source validation/holdout, 8 fixed epochs, final checkpoint.

execution.launch_owner: Codex source direct mixture pilot owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU0 after idle check; real source smoke with 32 L_s and 32 U_s; TF32 off
